name: Phoenix Finance missing delegateCallSwap authorization
summary: The main implementation exposed delegateCallSwap(bytes) without authorization and forwarded caller-supplied swap calldata to its configured swap module, so the attacker could route assets borrowed into the Phoenix proxy through an attacker-priced token pair.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact 10,258.326219 USDC transfer from the Phoenix money pool to the proxy in the exploit receipt. The attacker separately supplied 8,000 USDC to buyLeverage; after Phoenix's 8 USDC fee, 18,250.326219 USDC entered the attacker-priced pair and 18,142.669795 USDC returned to the attack contract. The attacker contract's transaction-level net was 10,132.669795 USDC after its 7,990 USDC flash-loan receipt and 8,000 USDC repayment. The commonly reported $100,000 figure is not used because it is not present in the selected transaction's onchain flows.

ageReset.description: Latest executable-code activation in the exploited route: the proxy's swap-module pointer changed to the module that later executed the attacker's swap calldata.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit receipt and call trace, commit-pinned reproduction, technical incident account, internal deployment trace, both code-selection writes, historical storage, and pre-exploit runtimes. The exploit calls buyLeverage on 0x65baf1dc6fa0c7e459a36e2e310836b396d1b1de, whose storage context delegates to main implementation 0x6d68beb09ea7e76d561ea8c4aac34a6611dd9821; its unprotected delegateCallSwap(bytes) then delegates selector 0xa9678a18 to swap module 0x95620f30263ac0b0b4ffd9b7465838084e89cb84. The receipt transfers exactly 10,258.326219 USDC from money pool 0xd0289082cf4c5c2ba448b4b9c67232729aa75efa. Factory 0x3ff9dfae26fa6e47c8e44fc2332067be7ffc73de internally created the execution context at block 17630226. The main pointer changed from 0x9dfee5855849ab89b9574a0dc41350a70e28b541 to the 24,503-byte artifact at block 19095584, transaction index 272; the artifact's pre-exploit hash is 0xdaea3c0796f1faaeb4409c72faa8fed85451d8f5c197b2e4314fe1b9b2616530. The later swap-module write at block 19172145, transaction index 24 is the latest executable-code activation in the causal route, remained selected through the exploit, and yields an age of 46,387,670 seconds.
